memory_candidates.content: Lean 4 functional induction over a WF worklist def (f.induct): the `have x := ...` binders in the definition occupy with-pattern slots in each case; a case whose scrutinee shape is generic (e.g. fuel not constructor-headed) cannot unfold via simp only [f] (leaf equations are shape-conditional) — use rw [f.eq_def] + simp only [] there; a dependent `match h : disc with` in the body resists rw [hstep] (motive not type-correct) — instead `split at hgo`, reconcile each arm with the induction-provided step equation via hstep.symm.trans heq (defeq bridges let-bound locals), subst the injEq components, and let iota reduction make `exact ih hgo` typecheck against the unreduced matcher application. Option.noConfusion can mis-infer universes on some/none mismatches; absurd h (by simp) is robust.

Carrying a pre-existing strategic sorry through a parallel-build port without raising the bare-sorry census: instead of duplicating the sorry token in the ported lemma, have the ported lemma's corresponding case CONSUME the old sorried lemma at a degenerate instantiation (e.g. fuel := 0 on a singleton worklist whose fuel-0 arm returns exactly the needed result). The obligation flows via sorryAx, grep census is unchanged, and the retirement commit later swaps token locations 1-for-1.
